_comment: The neutral option, and the one most likely to be picked by someone who does not want to think about wardrobe. Stonewashed and straight-leg are the two words doing the period work; without them a model returns a modern slim jean every time.
label: Checked shirt and jeans
wardrobe: a checked flannel shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, tucked into stonewashed straight-leg jeans with a plain brown leather belt
